# SIF paid-state native fixture

A distinct unarmed current entry role separately pins published5.0.20010; it does not replace the old successor. It uses the existing `tools/Invoke-NativeFixture.ps1` initial/save/two-cold lifecycle. Black Glass owns actual archive composition, protected-save custody, process admission, complete packet review and execution. Preparation and host controls are not native acceptance.

The independent source is the actual published4.7.20003 archive `FBBA844D…`, its `owner_policy.lua` `ABBB5CA8…` and hidden-only diagnostics `DA32D686…`, plus original state-oracle Git blob `f110e0916b95ef67e661e88939cd17237fc3592d` (`v4.7.3:tests/support/MIR421SpaceFakeUpgrade.lua`). The port retains five IDs and exactly11 recipe effects with counts3/2/1/3/2. Processing-unit productivity excludes scrap recycling. The old oracle's actual4.2-only seed and obsolete browser import are recorded history; this fixture declares its473 source explicitly and imports no retired implementation.

Compose each role from exactly its `info.json`, shared `control.lua` and shared `contract.lua`; package the raw committed Git blobs through the existing fixture packager and verify exact member/container hashes before staging. Use the three `tests/profiles/sif-retained-manufacturing-*-f200-2077.json` definitions, the exact existing F200 observer and the direct2.0 archive library. Fixture archive hashes, controller/caller/runtime/output inputs and final selected player bytes still need binding in the reviewed packet. A changed package requires a deliberate profile pin and applicability review; never silently replace the current private pin.

The source init alone seeds levels/progress, disables the paid processing-unit row, prepares native prerequisites, resets effects and creates a distinct foreign force with disabled native mining research and detached work. It records truth after the required two-entry native queue exists: native mining research first, retained plastic second, current progress0.42. Source capture records actual recipe bonuses after native effect application. It creates no labs and claims zero lab-earned progression. If the published native API refuses this hidden plastic queue, source preparation fails without fallback or a changed oracle.

Successor configuration validates all captured levels/researched/enabled/detached/current/queue/bonus and foreign states before creating the fresh comparison force. It never reseeds paid research, resets effects or replaces the queue. Cold callbacks only reset local observation flags; cold checks do not write storage, save again, reset effects or repair state. The existing runner must preserve the input save byte-for-byte and observe the ordinary successor save on two independent cold launches.

Current MIR5 exposes read-only native research queries and no research-enqueue API. The fixture checks actual hidden prototypes and exact effects, then uses `more-infinite-research.api.v1.get_research` to compare native state and verify the queue stays unchanged. It explicitly does not exercise GUI input or claim a Library enqueue-action verdict; wider Library input/action safety remains separately required. The source/fixture state, the old two-continuation SIF science campaign, full/compact settings, disable/readd transitions, performance and final release acceptance retain their distinct scopes.
